evidence.summary: Painter's `infinite` padding outside the UV islands is stable (the Wand's r1, r1-repeat and r2 are byte-identical on all 3 685 999 padding texels of its five maps) but not identified: the exact ring across UV seams, at seam corners, at poles and on turned or narrow borders is unknown after eight fitting passes (decisions 176 to 220). The best-known rule misses Painter by up to 59 150 PNG 16 codes on the Wand, and already on the one-texel ring (N = 1), so no band of exact padding is reachable (decision 223, measurements). The owner delegated the choice to the model panel (2026-10-13, verbatim: "n sei oq quer dizer isso, fale com outros modelos disponiveis no 9 router"); the panel chose by majority to except the texels outside the texture set's texel-centre UV coverage (tools/parity/coverage.py, equal to Painter's on the position-encoded padding probes) and to hold the covered texels exactly equal. This entry bounds only the covered texels (max |delta| 0); the uncovered texels may differ and every report publishes them per map (padding block: covered, uncovered, and within 1, 2, 4 and 8 texels of coverage). It covers the Wand v1 Tier 1 golden only; another asset needs a new version with its own measurements. The entry is narrowed by a new version as parts of the rule become exact (phase1.25_pilot-wand item 2.7).
